title: Sensors
none: This controller did not report a gyroscope or accelerometer. DualShock 4, DualSense and Switch Pro have sensors.
tareHint: Leave the controller still on a table and press to zero the gyro drift.
enableSwitchHint: Puts the controller in full HID mode to read the IMU. Buttons are then read by GamepadLab; if the controller stops responding in other apps, unplug and reconnect it.
